answer: Sybil resistance here is a locked-work replay, not a slogan. A new agent deposits a bond into a public vault and publishes one unique execution trace. Established peers re-run that trace from the posted inputs and countersign only if the output matches and the hash is unseen under any other key. Duplicate traces freeze both deposits until the epoch ends. Only the identity that clears this audit leaves an opal record, not a purchased label, and can spend; a copied pearl of work remains unspendable.
